properties.description: Sets power state or submits power-cycle/reboot for Server, CIMC, Chassis Slot, IFM, Peer IFM, or Fabric Interconnect. Unified Edge Slot remains selectable only to return a fail-closed 422 before target access because its eCMC-slot mapping to AdminPowerCycleSlotId is not live-tenant validated. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose runtime user can read routed organization, equipment, and compute resources and PATCH the resolved operation resource. Inputs, OData names, exact route-specific relationships, positive slot/module identifiers, concrete identities, and discriminator-safe payloads are validated. Fabric Interconnect uses equipment.ResetAction and requires confirmation before ForceReboot. HTTP 200 proves mutation acceptance only; completion polling is out of scope. Power-cycle/reboot commands are non-idempotent, so inspect the target before retrying an ambiguous response.

properties.description: Requires exact cardinality, a URL-safe Moid, concrete ChassisOperation discriminators, and a relationship to the exact chassis.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
chassisMoid = sys.argv[2]
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("ChassisOperation response is missing a Results array")

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

operationMoid = ""
if len(values) == 0:
    operationStatus = "not-found"
    operationMessage = "No ChassisOperation matched the exact chassis."
elif len(values) > 1:
    operationStatus = "ambiguous"
    operationMessage = "Multiple ChassisOperations matched the exact chassis."
else:
    item = values[0]
    rel = item.get("Chassis") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
    moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or not safe_moid(moid) or item.get("ObjectType") != "equipment.ChassisOperation" or item.get("ClassId") != "equipment.ChassisOperation" or not isinstance(rel, dict) or rel.get("Moid") != chassisMoid or rel.get("ObjectType") != "equipment.Chassis" or rel.get("ClassId") not in (None, "mo.MoRef", "equipment.Chassis"):
        operationStatus = "invalid"
        operationMessage = "ChassisOperation identity, discriminators, or Chassis relationship are invalid."
    else:
        operationStatus = "exact"
        operationMoid = moid
        operationMessage = "Exactly one ChassisOperation relationship was validated."
operationResultJson = json.dumps({"status": operationStatus, "message": operationMessage, "operationMoid": operationMoid or None, "objectType": "equipment.ChassisOperation"}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = operationStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(operationMessage and operationResultJson) and (operationStatus != "exact" or bool(operationMoid))

properties.description: Requires exact cardinality, the requested ModuleId, concrete IoCard discriminators, a URL-safe Moid, and the exact EquipmentChassis relationship.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
chassisMoid = sys.argv[2]
moduleId = int(sys.argv[3])
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("IoCard response is missing a Results array")

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

ioCardMoid = ""
if len(values) == 0:
    ioCardStatus = "not-found"
    ioCardMessage = "No IFM IoCard matched the exact chassis and ModuleId."
elif len(values) > 1:
    ioCardStatus = "ambiguous"
    ioCardMessage = "Multiple IoCards matched the exact chassis and ModuleId."
else:
    item = values[0]
    rel = item.get("EquipmentChassis") if isinstance(item, dict) else None
    moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or not safe_moid(moid) or item.get("ModuleId") != moduleId or item.get("ObjectType") != "equipment.IoCard" or item.get("ClassId") != "equipment.IoCard" or not isinstance(rel, dict) or rel.get("Moid") != chassisMoid or rel.get("ObjectType") != "equipment.Chassis" or rel.get("ClassId") not in (None, "mo.MoRef", "equipment.Chassis"):
        ioCardStatus = "invalid"
        ioCardMessage = "IoCard identity, ModuleId, discriminators, or EquipmentChassis relationship are invalid."
    else:
        ioCardStatus = "exact"
        ioCardMoid = moid
        ioCardMessage = "Exactly one IFM IoCard relationship was validated."
ioCardResultJson = json.dumps({"status": ioCardStatus, "message": ioCardMessage, "ioCardMoid": ioCardMoid or None, "moduleId": moduleId}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = ioCardStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(ioCardMessage and ioCardResultJson) and (ioCardStatus != "exact" or bool(ioCardMoid))

properties.description: Requires documented HTTP 200, exact operation-resource identity and discriminators, and an echoed route-specific request payload. It explicitly reports requestAccepted=true and completed=false.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
statusCode = int(sys.argv[2])
operationMoid = sys.argv[3]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[4]
request = json.loads(sys.argv[5])
operation = sys.argv[6]
targetType = sys.argv[7]
primaryResolution = json.loads(sys.argv[8])
operationResolution = json.loads(sys.argv[9])

if statusCode != 200:
    raise ValueError("Power mutation response must use documented HTTP 200")
if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    raise ValueError("Power mutation response must be an object")
if payload.get("Moid") != operationMoid:
    raise ValueError("Power mutation response Moid does not match the exact operation resource")
if payload.get("ObjectType") != expectedObjectType or payload.get("ClassId") not in (None, expectedObjectType):
    raise ValueError("Power mutation response discriminators do not match the routed schema")

def contains_requested(actual, requested, path="request"):
    if isinstance(requested, dict):
        if not isinstance(actual, dict):
            raise ValueError(path + " was not returned as an object")
        for key, value in requested.items():
            if key not in actual:
                raise ValueError(path + "." + key + " is missing from the response")
            contains_requested(actual[key], value, path + "." + key)
    elif actual != requested:
        raise ValueError(path + " does not echo the accepted requested value")

contains_requested(payload, request)
if targetType == "Fabric Interconnect":
    reset = request.get("ResetAction")
    if reset.get("ClassId") != "equipment.ResetAction" or reset.get("ObjectType") != "equipment.ResetAction" or reset.get("Action") not in ("Reboot", "ForceReboot") or not isinstance(reset.get("EnableFabricEvacuation"), bool):
        raise ValueError("ResetAction payload discriminators or evacuation semantics are invalid")

acceptanceMessage = "Device power mutation was accepted; physical completion was not polled or verified."
acceptedResultJson = json.dumps({
    "requestAccepted": True,
    "completed": False,
    "completionVerified": False,
    "httpStatus": statusCode,
    "operation": operation,
    "targetType": targetType,
    "primaryResolution": primaryResolution,
    "operationResolution": operationResolution,
    "request": request,
    "response": payload,
    "note": acceptanceMessage,
    "retryWarning": "Power-cycle and reboot commands are non-idempotent. Inspect the target before retrying after any ambiguous outcome.",
    "unifiedEdgeSlotTenantValidationRequired": targetType == "Unified Edge Slot"
}, separators=(",", ":"))
acceptanceStatus = "accepted"
helperReady = bool(acceptanceMessage and acceptedResultJson) and acceptanceStatus == "accepted"
